title: humata griffithiana
intro: Humata griffithiana, commonly known as the Indian cord fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the family of true ferns. It is native to parts of Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, fever, and various infections. The health benefits of Humata griffithiana include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, tannins, and other phenolic compounds, which also contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
